found: Coursed limestone ashlar on the recipe's own 8 courses of 4 blocks in half bond, with the joints and arrises where the structure puts them. Weathered stone with algae streaks, black spotting and prominent scallop shells. The shells read as whole shells applied to the surface rather than as fossil sections through the stone, which is an oddity rather than a mark. No lettering, numeral, logo, badge, signature, watermark or mason's mark anywhere in the four crops, and nothing that reads as a particular real building.
statement: Every texel of every map is inside exactly one of these crops, each written at 1:1 with no resampling, and each was looked at before this set was offered for publication.
